notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S120 (road train symbol, 1960 x 350). Layout: 1960 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol double road train, side view x 55-1910 y 42-308.
